items.title: TPG, IMM PE vie for control of $746 million CGBio in renewed buyout race
items.subject: IMM
items.why: TPG is reported to be moving on IMM in North Asia ($746 million): a buy-side tech DD is being scoped now.
items.call: Call the TPG North Asia deal team today and offer to scope the buy-side tech DD before advisers are set.

items.title: GIC Acquires 16 Hotel Marriott Portfolio from KKR
items.subject: Marriott
items.why: KKR has agreed to sell Marriott in Southeast Asia: VDD is spent; the buyer owns integration and KKR has proceeds to redeploy.
items.call: Two calls: the buyer’s deal team on integration, and the KKR team on what the proceeds go into next.

items.title: TPG Explores Hybrid ADR Structure With New and Existing Shares as Kakao Mobility Exit Stalls
items.subject: Kakao Mobility
items.why: TPG is preparing a listing of Kakao Mobility in Asia after 9y 3m, in the exit window: pre-IPO tech VDD and the equity story get scoped now.
items.call: Call the TPG portfolio team this week: pitch the pre-IPO tech VDD and the technology chapter of the equity story.

items.title: TPG-managed NewQuest sells another Rs 115 crore worth of Shadowfax shares in bulk deal
items.subject: Shadowfax
items.why: TPG has agreed to sell Shadowfax in India or ANZ (Rs 115 crore): VDD is spent; the buyer owns integration and TPG has proceeds to redeploy.
items.call: Two calls: the buyer’s deal team on integration, and the TPG team on what the proceeds go into next.

items.title: KKR (KKR) Joined A Non Binding Bid For Uniper SE
items.subject: Uniper SE
items.why: KKR is in a live process for Uniper SE: bids are moving and the diligence window is open.
items.call: Call the KKR deal team now: confirmatory tech DD, and a red-flag view on the stack if they are not yet in exclusivity.
